body: Residual from the V1-1437 lane (PR #941). The V1-1331 correction re-emitted case 21 (go1.24.13-nonstructural-positive). Its new citation/verdict value was derived from the sealed values with --values; the derivation reproduced the native capture on two control cases, but no run was observed that actually executes case 21 in the portable stable test (it may report NOT_RUN on this host). Until then case 21's value is checked only by the derivation.
